note: Legal identity two paths (owner decision 2026-11-20): a business file's legal identity is never changed after the fact. Path A = exempt → authorized dealer inside the same file through a controlled flow; Path B = any change of legal name / id number / legal form opens a new business file. Pure suites, executed by security-gate.yml straight from this manifest (lab pure). The database half is .bkt/battery.ts in business-kind-transition-lab.yml (migration PR).

lib/legal-identity/identity-change-polic.reason: pure (no DB/network): every requested identity change is classified — exempt → authorized only as Path A, any legal name / id number / legal form change (even a one-character typo) as a new business file, authorized → exempt and unknown kinds refused, no message carries a typed value

lib/legal-identity/kind-transition.test..reason: pure (no DB/network): the exempt → authorized flow is offered only to an exempt dealer's authorized user on a complete, live business; same-entity proof (retyped id must match the file), valid VAT number, every acknowledgement required (no partial consent), canonical statement digest binds business, actor, identity and VAT number

lib/auth/sensitive-reauth.test.ts.reason: pure (no DB/network): the step-up proof is bound to user + session + action + method, expires in 5 minutes, refuses tampering and never validates as an admin elevation or a Google state; Google re-auth forces prompt=login/max_age=0, requires a fresh auth_time and the SAME linked user, sets the proof only as an httpOnly cookie on the action path; the shared callback takes the re-auth branch only on its own valid state cookie, ordinary sign-in unchanged

lib/services/legal-identity/kind-transit.reason: pure (injected deps): OFF → 404 before the session is read; the session decides user and business; confirm needs a proof for this user, session and action by the method the account requires (password account → PASSWORD); stale digest, ineligible business, missing or foreign proof reach no database call; database answers mapped; the proof is cleared only on success
